section_table_format: OVLMGR.INC info_section: is_address (load seg), is_fname (ptr to length-prefixed file name), is_fpos (3 bytes, paragraphs), is_flags (byte: 01 preload, 02 in memory, 04 cache, 08 data save, 10 committed, 20 compressed), is_memsize, is_num_relocs, is_father (FFFF), is_section_num (index+2), is_filesize. docs/exe-format.md 'file_para, flags' = fpos low word, then (fpos high byte, flags byte): 0x500 = PRELOAD|CACHE, 0x400 = CACHE, 0x100 = PRELOAD.

relocation_order_model.rule: entries grouped per frame by target symbol; group order = (bucket(handle(c)), -i): c = creation index of the target's symbol record, i = insertion index into the relocation hash (first relocating fixup, pass 2); 101 buckets, chains most-recent-first
relocation_order_model.creation_index: symbol records are created while objects are read in command-line order: PUBDEF immediately (record order); an external at its first FIXUPP reference (any fixup kind, FIXUPP order); EXTDEF-only symbols at the end of the object. Names, EXTDEF order, unreferenced EXTDEFs, site addresses, fixups per symbol and extra SEGDEFs have no influence.
relocation_order_model.bucket_function: bucket(c) steps by 9 mod 101 (3.11 = 3.13, identical permutation for c < 4000) and by 70 mod 101 (6.10), with periodic extra steps (VM handle hashing); version-specific
relocation_order_model.consequence: the original names are NOT needed (refutes the name-hash hypothesis of docs/level-c-link.md); the complete object set in the original command-line order and the exact RTLink/Plus version are. SimAnt's order tested against the 3.1x and 6.10 functions (K0 scan on runtime-created symbols, per-module block fit): chance level (<= 66%).

vector_model.ALWAYS: vectors for ALWAYS symbols first, in the listed order (v1/b)
vector_model.on_demand: then first reference in pass 2 order (v1/a)
vector_model.NEVER: 6.10 builds a vector for every cross-unit reference to an overlay symbol, far pointers in data included; the original's direct references into S00-S03 and the data dispatch tables require NEVER
vector_model.format: E8 rel16 -> $$OVLLOADIL, EA off seg, dw section index (0-based): identical in 6.10
